The integration of these relationships implies that beta-Cuprenene may act as a modulator of the signaling pathway involving 12-O-Deacetyl-12-Epi-19-Deoxy-22-Hydroxyscalarin, potentially through a mechanism that involves the regulation of SCCH-26's function.
